hints: The Snag'em contact grins: "Anything works on this one. It is here to teach you."
A bystander says: "Fight beside it. That is all it wants."
Its purification ring shows a plain circle: any method will do.
The Snag'em contact sneers: "A present with strings. Good luck with the strings."
A passer-by says: "It only ever softened for someone who stayed."
Its purification ring shows a footprint: it has to be walked with, battle after battle.
Namba's technician boasts: "Locked it up in a lab. It has not seen the sky in years."
A researcher says: "Once the technician is out of the way, take it outside and let it lead."
Its purification ring shows a small horizon: win one battle outdoors with it leading.
A Rocket grunt laughs: "That fossil? It belongs to us now. Nobody will ever stamp it."
A museum guide says: "If only that fossil were officially registered."
Its purification ring shows a small stamp: the Pewter Museum has to register its fossil.
A poacher brags: "Her little one is in the truck. She will do anything we say."
A ranger says: "She is not angry at you. She wants her child."
Its purification ring shows a small shape beside a large one: return her child.
A Rocket scientist mutters: "Nothing but the Tower itself will ever clear that fog."
A mourner in Lavender says: "The old rites at the Tower, that is the only thing that works."
Its purification ring shows a tower: only a Site Cleansing at Pokémon Tower sets it free.
A Rocket grunt shivers: "It keeps looking for something. Something small."
An old woman says: "She lost her child at the Tower. Take it a little Cubone, if you can."
Its purification ring shows a skull and a small one beside it: the orphan Cubone, at the top of the Tower.
